title: The normalized adjacent input coefficient transition
statement: For any scheme X, completed derived coefficient object K, and n≥0, restrict the scalar-adjunction-defined CompactSupportProperImageTower.reductionMap K n to completed coefficients and compose with the normalized restriction compositor. The result is sfDerivedReductionTransition n at K. There is no scheme map, direct image, completeness, or constructibility hypothesis.

proof.text: Identify normalizedDVRModuleRes at adjacent indices with restriction along compactSupportLevelQuotient by the successor equation for the coefficient sheaf system. The ordinary pbc restriction compositor is the equality-induced isomorphism: substitute the composite ring map and use its identity-on-sections uniqueness characterization. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso then identifies compactSupportSystemRestrictionComp with the direct quotient compositor, preceded by the derived presentation isomorphism. These are proved private comparison lemmas in the item module.

Apply the scalar-adjunction Hom bijection to compare the two quotient transposes after the presentation isomorphism. Naturality on the right and the compositor equality cancel the inverse/forward presentation maps. Restrict this equality to completed coefficients and compose with the corresponding compositors. This yields the left side of sfDirectImageInputTransition_adjacent; apply that existing theorem. All comparisons are valid at n=0 and the zero complex, without any completeness or geometric assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem sfNormalizedInputTransition
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (n : ℕ) :
    (coefficientFiniteDerivedRestriction l E X (n + 1)).map
          (CompactSupportProperImageTower.reductionMap l E X K n) ≫
        (compactSupportSystemRestrictionComp l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).hom.app
          ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K) =
      (sfDerivedReductionTransition l E X n).app K
